# InlineAlert

Not `role="alert"`, despite its name. It is not a live region: it renders no `role` and no `aria-live`, so mounting one announces nothing, and announcing stays the application's — route the same event through a `ToastRegion` or an `Announcement` if it must be spoken. A status message that sits inside content (D86): above a form, in a panel. A tinted surface with a 1px border in the variant's colour and a radius; it fills the width of its container rather than setting its own. Presentational and stateless, with no dismiss button. For a page-wide strip, use `Banner`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `"neutral" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger"` | neutral | no | Status variant. |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | — | no | A short heading, rendered before the body in the medium weight. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | yes | The message: bare text, or one or more `<p>`. A direct `<p>` has no block margin, and consecutive paragraphs are 8px apart (D95). |
| `action` | `ReactNode` | — | no | Trailing affordance — a ghost Button (Review, Retry, Learn more). |
| `statusLabel` | `string \| null` | — | no | The visually hidden status word (D83). A string replaces the default ("Success:", "Warning:", "Error:") — pass the translated word; `null` drops it. Unset keeps the default, and `neutral` has none. |
| `className` | `string` | — | no | Additional CSS class name(s) merged onto the component's root element. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | — | no | Forwarded ref to the underlying `<div>`. |

## Keyboard & assistive tech

| Keys | Behavior |
|---|---|
| Tab | Reaches the action when present. The alert itself is not focusable. |
| Enter / Space | Activates the focused action. |

Not a live region, and not role="alert" despite its name: it renders no role and no aria-live, so mounting an InlineAlert announces nothing; announcing stays the application's (route the same event through a ToastRegion or an Announcement if it must be spoken). Presentational (D86): it holds no state and has no dismiss button. The variant's meaning is carried by a visually hidden status word ("Success:", "Warning:", "Error:"), never by colour, border and icon shape alone; the icon is aria-hidden. neutral has no status and gets no word. statusLabel replaces that word with a translated one, or drops it with null (D83). Place it in reading order before the content it qualifies, such as above the form it is about.

## Theming

Override `--psi-inline-alert-*` custom properties at any scope.

## Variant guidance

- **accent** — Primary action, draws attention. Submit, CTA, main action in a group.
- **accent-subtle** — Accent tone, lower visual weight. Selected state, active filter, soft CTA.
- **neutral** — Default, structurally present. Secondary actions, toolbar buttons.
- **neutral-subtle** — Minimal chrome. Inline actions, table row actions.
- **ghost** — No visible container until hover. Icon-only triggers, compact toolbars.
- **outline** — Bordered ghost — visible structure, no fill until hover. Marketing CTA, download button; hover fills accent.
- **danger** — Destructive action. Delete, remove, disconnect.
- **danger-subtle** — Destructive context, low urgency. Warning badges, soft destructive hints.
- **success | warning** — Status communication (Tag only). Status badges, labels.

## Rules

- One accent per visual group; everything else neutral or ghost.
- danger only for actions with real consequences.
- Sizes are px numbers (24|32|40|48), never S/M/L.
- Typography tokens are --psi-text-{size}-{lineHeight}-{weight}.
- Override component tokens (--psi-{component}-*), not semantic tokens, for one-off theming.
- --psi-button-font overrides button typography across all sizes (documented D34 override; ember → mono).
- Wrap labeled form controls in Field — label association, description/error line, aria-describedby and aria-invalid come wired; don't hand-roll label+message rows.
- Field is for a control with a *visible* label. A toolbar filter control named by aria-label or placeholder takes neither a Field nor a hand-rolled label row — compare filter-toolbar (no labels) with table-pagination ("Rows per page" visible, so Field). Filters with visible labels submitted together by a Find button are filter-form: a Toolbar as="form" align="start" of Fields with one-line labels, where a field's error line is the Field's own and hangs below its control (D87, D92).
- Label beside its control: <Field labelPosition="start"> for one field in a toolbar or pager (keep Toolbar align="center"); <FieldStack labelPosition="start"> for a form whose labels share one column, as wide as the longest label up to --psi-field-label-max-width, stacking below 480px of the form's width. A theme sets --psi-field-label-align: end to put labels against their controls (D115).
- Width of a control: <Field controlWidth={80|120|160|240|320|480}> sizes the control it wraps in px and lets it shrink in a narrower column; the label and message keep the Field's width. Pick the step from the value: at size 32 an Input fits about 7/12/17/26/36/55 digits (an ICCID's 20 digits → 240; a page-size Select → 80). Without it the control fills the Field. A FieldStack stops at --psi-field-stack-max-width (640px); filter-form controls keep their natural width unless a Field sets controlWidth (D125).
- A popup's maximum height is --psi-popup-max-height (320px), shared by every popup through its own alias (--psi-menu-max-height); past it the popup scrolls. Override the alias for one component, the shared token for all (D131).
- Use Dialog for blocking modal flows — title/footer slots, dismissible gate; danger stays on the footer Buttons, one accent per group.
- Text links are Link (React) or the .psi-link class on any <a>: accent colour, underlined at rest, never by colour alone (D119). A router app passes its own link as Link's only child. Button href is for an action that should look like a button. Inside a NavItem or among NavBar's links, pass your router link itself, not Link.
- Pick between Tabs, SegmentedControl and RadioGroup by the job (D132). Switch 2–4 views of one region compactly (Map/Trace, Preview/Code): <Tabs> with a <SegmentedControl aria-label> of <Segment>s in place of TabList, plus a TabPanel per segment; Tabs owns the value. Switch page sections, more than 4 views, or a vertical list: Tabs + TabList + Tab. Pick one of 2–4 short options that applies at once (Light/Dark/System, a theme): <SegmentedControl aria-label value onValueChange> on its own, a radio group. A value a form submits, options with descriptions, or more than 4: RadioGroup (Select for many). An action: Button or Toolbar. Segment labels are one or two words; the control never wraps, and truncates them when its container is narrower; fill shares the width equally. Sizes 24|32|40.
- A count after a label is Count (D124): neutral by default; tone="attention" is a pill and should carry a label ("4 stuck"), since the tone is visual. A Count is never a live region. In a NavTree, pass it as NavItem's count, and an icon as icon on NavItem or NavGroup; the icon is decorative and sized by the tree.
